title: Setup nav: People & Organization has no entries for the new Position holders and Permission set assignment pages (security:position-holders, security:permission-set-assignment)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibz8HEj53Wx2uphTo2o

Filing gate: ④ the server half of epic #28236 child N-27 (#28241), carried out of the ui PR as a finding (os-dev-report 6538865255 on #28241). ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #28236 (N-27) · lane: `domain:server` · size: S.

## Business reason

**Who:** an administrator assigning people (Setup → People & Organization). **What happens:** PR #28310 adds the two Setup pages ADR-0146 D7 asks for, registered as console components `security:position-holders` and `security:permission-set-assignment`, but Setup's navigation is server metadata, so no entry opens them; they are reachable by typed URL only. **If not done:** when the metadata catalog moves to Studio (N-26) an administrator has no Setup route to add a holder or assign a permission set.

## Mechanism

- Setup's People & Organization group is declared in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` (`group: 'group_people_org'`), and plugin-security contributes its own Setup entries in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` (`navigationContributions`, ≈L1637; Positions / Permission Sets in Access Control).
- A `type: 'component'` entry with `componentRef` is the established shape (`nav_packaged_automation` → `automation:packaged` in the same file; #12457 is the precedent of a page merged with no entry naming its ref).

## Wanted

Two `type: 'component'` entries under `group_people_org`: "Position Holders" → `componentRef: 'security:position-holders'` and "Permission Set Assignment" → `componentRef: 'security:permission-set-assignment'`, contributed by plugin-security (the pages' data are its objects), gated as its Positions / Permission Sets entries are (`setup.access`, delegated-administrator scope), with labels in the Setup app's translation bundles.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Both entries appear under People & Organization for an administrator and open the two pages; hidden where plugin-security's other Setup entries are hidden.
- [ ] Labels translated where the bundle carries the group.

## Reader and dedupe

- **Who acts:** `domain:server` (plugin-security / platform-objects).
- **Lands after:** PR #28310 (the pages) merges; the entries are harmless before it (a component ref with no registration shows the console's not-found page).
- **Dedupe:** the `group_people_org` contributions on `main` name no component entry; no open issue names these refs (they were created by #28310).

Refs #28241 · Refs #28236 · Refs #12457
